title: Legacy crash retrievals: luring craft with psionics, then downing them with directed energy

tellings.quote: almost creating this like honeypot of like hey we love you come see us

plain: Secret long-running programs, called legacy programs, are said to lure UFOs over the desert using psionics (people with claimed psychic abilities), sending a message like "hey we love you come see us" as a sort of honeypot, and then bring the craft down with directed energy weapons, which are beams of focused energy. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into the UFO program as a child, tells this on Michels' show, crediting the journalist Ross Coulthart. If true, it would mean some crash recoveries were not accidents but traps.
